text: Bulgur soaks up the yoghurt and ferments with it for several days, so the acidity keeps rising while the grain softens. Drying and milling turn the mixture into a powder that keeps and is cooked into soup.

links.name: Salameh et al., Options Méditerranéennes A 123 (CIHEAM 2019)

steps.note: Bulgur is mixed with yoghurt at about 1 part to 3, and strained yoghurt is added.
The dough is kneaded daily, in the lab for 36 h and then 4 d.
The dough is shaped into balls.
The balls are left out in the sun.
